name: The majority voted in favour of an [amendment](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2023-09-07.28.1) that: > *At the end of the motion, add: "and, in respect of the [Water Amendment (Restoring Our Rivers) Bill 2023](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7076), the Environment and Communications Legislation Committee report on 8 November 2023."* This means that vote was successful and that the bill we be referred to the committee for [an inquiry and report](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Committees/Senate/Environment_and_Communications/MDBAWaterBill2023).
